question: That sovereignty of that very one is ordained by the supreme Lord; this has been determined and elaborated by me alone elsewhere?
premises: sovereignty is ordained by the supreme Lord
it was elaborated by me alone elsewhere
inference: The sovereignty doctrine is ordained by the supreme Lord and elaborated by the author elsewhere.
plain_english: That sovereignty of that very one is ordained by the supreme Lord; this has been determined, and it was elaborated by me alone elsewhere, because.
